results.rationale: Consistency: turquoise sandal, pink nails, rainy ground and framing persist; slight sandal sole contour change is visible. Instruction: all seven toes remain, so the conspicuous extra-toe anatomy is not corrected. Quality: despite convincing skin, polish and rain texture, seven toes and finger-like elongated proportions are a major anatomical failure.

Consistency: gray-white setting remains, but the upright cup shifts/changes scale and an extra cup is added. Instruction: the original left cup still lies on its side; a third cup is placed partly over the right cup instead of moving the left one. Quality: intersecting cup walls, ambiguous support and fused overlap between upper and right cups create multiple distracting structural errors.
